t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are six types of gnomes. The brown, red, and pink gnomes will produce the red basket and the green, blue, and yellow gnomes will produce a yellow basket. Pick one color basket and stick with it until you notice a decrease in mushrooms, then switch.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes come in matched sets (ie Purple v. Blue, Red v. Yellow, etc). Choose the gnome with the smaller hat in each set, then decide by color. For example, Purple and Blue both have tall hats, and which gnome provided more mushrooms could change, but overall felt consistent. Pick a strategy and understand that your brain recognizes patterns before your conscious mind does, so go with your gut!
